# Whole Words in Narrow Cards

Version 3.2.2 keeps the card readable in narrow layouts, understands older "last updated" dates in more languages, and catches a mistyped ski area path before it becomes an entry.

## The card in narrow layouts

- **Words and numbers are no longer torn apart.** In a narrow slot, for example the minimum width on a phone, a label could break letter by letter and a figure such as `156/214 km` could split in the middle of the number. Labels now wrap only between words, long words are hyphenated, and a figure breaks at the space or not at all. The card is also laid out more tightly below about 220 px: the icon sits above the text and the figures stack in a single column when the card gets very narrow. The minimum width of the card in a sections dashboard stays at 6 columns.

## "Last updated" times

- **Older reports keep their time.** A report older than a week is printed as a full date on the resort page, in the shape of each language. Those dates were not read, so the entity had no "last updated" time. The full dates of English, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, Danish, Hungarian, Swedish, Norwegian and Slovenian pages are now understood. The other languages already worked. _[#80]_ _[#81]_
- **Region overviews keep theirs too.** bergfex now prints the update time of the region snow report as an ISO timestamp, which was dropped. It is read again. _[#74]_

## Adding a resort

- **A mistyped path is caught in the dialog.** A ski area path typed by hand used to be accepted without a look, and a typo became an entry that kept retrying a missing page. The page is now checked first, and the dialog shows an error instead. Paths picked from the list are not checked again. _[#71]_

## Privacy

- **The webhook address stays out of the debug log.** The log no longer contains the webhook URL or the payload, and the URL is masked in the webhook error message. _[#72]_

## Smaller changes

- The integration is filed under "Weather and alerts" in the catalog. _[#62]_
- The README names the Marketplace next to HACS, and no longer lists the TRMNL plugin, whose author moved on. _[#68]_ _[#70]_
- Sensors are built on Home Assistant's coordinator entity. Entity IDs, unique IDs and polling are unchanged. _[#83]_

## Upgrading

Nothing to change after updating. Reload the page once so the browser picks up the new card.
